leads.title: reward-manager: distribute_rewards and distribute_rewards_authorized are identic
leads.desc:
## Problem

The docs say `distribute_rewards_authorized` "carries and authenticates the calling contract explicitly", unlike the legacy entrypoint, but both run the same `require_authorized_distributor` and `distribute_rewards_impl`. Keeping two names increases the audited surface for no benefit.

leads.title: reward-manager: contract_version returns the constructor-time value after an upg
leads.desc:
## Problem

`contract_version` returns the `CVER` stored at construction and only falls back to `CONTRACT_VERSION` when nothing is stored. After a WASM upgrade that bumps `CONTRACT_VERSION`, the contract still reports the old version, and `verify_deployment.sh` and compatibility checks get it wrong.

leads.title: reward-manager: get_pool_audit_log's start_after is an offset, and total counts
leads.desc:
## Problem

The parameter is named `start_after` but is a 0-based offset into the retained window, and `total` returns the lifetime count rather than the retained count. Clients that page until `offset >= total` loop forever once the ring buffer wraps.
